name: Glass Cannon
desc: +30% damage of every kind, -25% max HP. Shine brighter, briefly.

name: Point Blank
desc: +40% ranged damage against enemies within arm's reach of regret.

name: Cinder
desc: Enemies that die while burning explode, sharing the warmth.

name: Frostfire
desc: Freezing a burning enemy detonates all remaining burn at double strength.

name: Homing Instinct
desc: Your projectiles curve gently toward enemies. They mean well.

name: Overflow
desc: Overkill damage on a kill splashes to the nearest enemy. Waste not.

name: Conductor
desc: Your chains and bounces jump one extra time. Encore!

name: Grave Dividend
desc: Your zombies drop 1 gold when they expire. Politely.

name: Bee Yourself
desc: Gain a tiny bee. It's not much. It believes in you.

name: Second Course
desc: Hearts and snacks heal 25% more. Always room for seconds.

name: Static Charge
desc: Stand still for a second and your next hit stuns. Patience crackles.

name: Thick Wax
desc: +15% max HP and +1 armor. Sturdy is a lifestyle.

name: Fleet Wick
desc: +8% move speed and +4% dodge. Somewhere to be, apparently.

name: Night Scholar
desc: +20% experience. The midnight oil burns you.

name: Magpie Eye
desc: +20% gold and +25% pickup radius. Shiny things know your name.

name: Steady Flame
desc: +1 HP regeneration per second. Slow and stubborn wins.
